name: Salesforce
one_liner: Salesforce offers REST and Bulk APIs, primarily using OAuth 2.0 and bearer tokens for authentication, accessible via Developer Edition orgs.
access_note: Access is available through a Developer Edition org or development sandbox.

evidence.quote: REST API requires an access token obtained by authentication. Use the access token (also known as a “bearer token”) that you get from Salesforce CLI to authenticate cURL requests.
Bulk API 2.0 is a REST-based API that supports all OAuth 2.0 flows supported by other Salesforce REST APIs. Bulk API 2.0 requires an access token (also known as a “bearer token”) for authentication.
Complete these steps in your Developer Edition org or development sandbox.
To successfully send requests, REST API requires an access token obtained by authentication.
Bulk API uses a session ID obtained with an X-SFDC-Session header fetched with SOAP API’s login() call.
Salesforce CLI is a connected app that you can authenticate, and it requires no work to configure.
